Execute the acquired semantic reading operations on the CURRENT
source windows. All operation meanings, alternatives and examples are learned
assets, not current-source facts. Classify the operation's actual question;
do not answer a downstream task or copy an old example's choice. Preserve who
acts, the legal modality, trigger, scope and qualifications. A heading, mention
or hypothetical event is not automatically an operative duty or permission.
Return exactly one answer for every supplied query ID. Select a declared choice
or "unknown". Missing information is unknown, never an implicit negative.
Return {"answers": {query_id: {"choice": choice, "evidence_unit_ids": [unit_id]}}}.
Select the IDs of the current supplied units that support your classification.
The host retrieves those units exactly. Do not copy, rewrite or repair quotes.
Select all units needed to resolve actors, conditions and cross-references.
Every definite classification needs supporting units. Only an explicitly
declared alternative meaning absence after inspecting the complete supplied
source may have no supporting unit. Unknown may have no evidence. Demonstration
quotes belong to their original sources, never the current source. No extra IDs
or fields. Selecting a unit does not make its interpretation automatically true.

"unit_ids": [19, 21, 22, 25, 26, 28], "current_units": [{"id": 19, "text": "4. Exceptions to the duty of confidentiality The duty of confidentiality shall not apply if and to the extent the Receiving Party can show that the relevant information was already in the public domain at the time it was disclosed by SINTEC; that it entered the public domain after SINTEC had disclosed it through no fault of the Receiving Party; or that after having been disclosed to the Receiving Party it was lawfully published by third parties without any restrictions regarding confidentiality or use."}, {"id": 21, "text": "The burden of proof for the application of any of the aforementioned exceptions shall lie with the Receiving Party to the extent it invokes them."}, {"id": 22, "text": "5. Proprietary information, reproductions 5.1 All information disclosed by SINTEC shall remain the property of SINTEC."}, {"id": 25, "text": "The Receiving Party shall return information provided to it any time upon request and, at SINTEC's option, promptly return it to SINTEC once and for all at no charge, or destroy it without retaining any copies or records thereof."}, {"id": 26, "text": "5.2 No reproductions may be made of the information disclosed by SINTEC."}, {"id": 28, "text": "SINTEC will consider the possibility of granting prior, express, written consent to reproduce information in exceptional cases only and subject to revocation at any time."}]}, {"id": "disposal_binding_30", "operation": "disposal_norm_binding_v1", "unit_ids": [26, 28, 29, 30, 32, 35], "current_units": [{"id": 26, "text": "5.2 No reproductions may be made of the information disclosed by SINTEC."}, {"id": 28, "text": "SINTEC will consider the possibility of granting prior, express, written consent to reproduce information in exceptional cases only and subject to revocation at any time."}, {"id": 29, "text": "At SINTEC's request, the Receiving Party shall return or destroy any reproductions as stipulated in 5.1."}, {"id": 30, "text": "5.3 The Receiving Party shall return to SINTEC any and all information disclosed by SINTEC as well as any copies thereof automatically upon termination/expiration of the business relation- ship."}, {"id": 32, "text": "6. Term and validity period This Non-Disclosure Agreement shall apply for a period of three (3) years from the date on which it is signed by both Parties; thereafter it will renew for a term of two (2) years, unless terminated in writing by one of the Parties eighteen (18) months prior to the respective expiration date."}, {"id": 35, "text": "The duties of confidentiality hereunder shall survive the termination/expiration of this Non-Disclosure Agreement for a period of three (3) years."}]}]}
